offering_description.value: CorVel administers workers’ compensation and other casualty claims for employers, insurers and public agencies. It also helps insurers, health plans and claims administrators review medical bills and manage care through clinical teams, provider networks and claims software.

primary_services.value: Claims administration; medical case management; utilization review; medical bill review and payment integrity; provider network management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Self-insured employers, insurers, health plans and third-party claims administrators; B2G: Public agencies that sponsor workers’ compensation or liability programs

end_markets.value: Workers’ compensation; auto and general liability insurance; group health benefits

revenue_model.value: service fees: Claims administration, clinical case management, medical bill review and access to provider networks

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Processes claims and medical bills and coordinates care for employers, insurers and public agencies

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Claims administration, clinical managed care, provider networks and healthcare payment integrity

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Contract sales to employers, insurers, health plans and public agencies; online: Client portals for claims and medical bill management

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State licensing for claims administration where required, state workers’ compensation rules and health information privacy requirements

notes: Standalone sales of its claims software are unclear.
